title: What's new in v2.7.1
summary: Find any setting by typing what it does, not by remembering which tab it lives on.

steps.title: Settings search
steps.listLabel: Find any setting without knowing its tab
steps.body: You no longer need to know which tab a setting lives on. Type what you are after and press **Enter**. It matches what a setting does as well as what it is called, so **docsis** finds **Cable Modem Monitoring** and **kiosk** finds **UI / Display Settings**.
